# PDF.js 6.5.438

Bundled from the official `pdfjs-dist` npm distribution, version 6.5.438:
https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.5.438

Official documentation: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/

Only the browser module, worker, renderer, standard fonts and associated WASM files are included. Original copyright/licence files are retained. `LICENSE.txt` is the main Apache-2.0 licence; font and decoder licences are beside their respective files.

The app renders user-selected PDF bytes locally into a canvas. It does not use a hosted PDF viewer or enable a PDF scripting interface. Files are never sent to a conversion service.
